title: The Why Quiet Is Kept at the Ramp
youtube_title: The Why Quiet Is Kept at the Ramp | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Yelena about why quiet is kept near the ramp. Yelena wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
